title: Telemetry
description: One wearable sample, sent by the Raspberry Pi bridge to POST /incidents/{id}/telemetry about 5 times per second.

steps.description: Running step count since boot. The server computes deltas.

heading.description: Degrees from the gyroscope. Relative and drifts slowly: use changes, never absolute values.

pressure.description: Air pressure in pascals. About 40-50 Pa drop per floor climbed.

btn.description: 0 none, 1 confirm (checkpoint or elevator ride), 2 'elevator out'.

tag.description: RFID tag UID if a tag was scanned in this sample, else null.
